summary: 在 ADR 0012 的 onboarding 插件内实现 PH-353 导入提交首片：新增 ImportPreview/ImportConflict/ImportSubmissionReceipt 模型与 onboarding 首个 0001_initial 迁移；persist_preview 持久化规范化 sha256 行摘要的 ready 预览与去重冲突（零业务事实）；commit_import 在公司锁+单事务内校验同 org 预览/版本/未消费、重算 rows_digest、复用 PH-354 period_precheck_snapshot 重算并比对 precheck_digest/as_of（blocker/can_close=false → precheck_blocked）、阻断未消解 blocker 冲突、request_token 同输入幂等/改输入冲突、稳定 import_key 去重、dry_run 零写，最终仅经 core.imports.apply_rows 调用既有 owner 服务，任一行失败整批回滚，成功后预览置 consumed；新增 owner/finance 提交页、auditor 历史只读、pm/member 拒绝、模块停用 history_read 的 history_read+business_write 路由与 ui-tokens 模板。新测试 33 项（26 服务 + 7 HTTP）。 复核修复：commit/dry_run 在调用 owner 服务前逐行校验业务日期所属期间（time=work_date、expense=occurred_on、plan=due_date），跨期行以 row_date_invalid 拒绝且零写。

findings: Initial review blocker: rows were not bound to the submitted period, so a current-month precheck could admit a prior-month row. Fixed by per-row month check in commit/dry_run (row_date_invalid) with regressions.
Final review PASS at e09e782: 33 scoped tests OK, full suite 1413 with only the established macOS baseline, verify-change only the review gate, report/handoff counts and BASE evidence updated.

review.evidence: Independent final verdict PASS; projectctl check ok/323; verify-change --base 8e3f877 only high_risk_review_required before this record.

deviations: Append-only receipt ordering: apply_rows writes owner facts first and the committed receipt is created with result_refs afterwards inside the same transaction.atomic; any failure still rolls back the whole batch. The contract's pending→committed update order is impossible with an append-only receipt that cannot be updated.

Conflict resolution uses the task-specified single ImportConflict row with a one-way null→accept/reject/merge transition and ORM immutability guards; no separate append-only resolution history table is added because the task whitelist/spec did not authorize one. Config fields become immutable once created.
period/as_of same-month mismatch is raised by PH-354 as ValidationError and mapped to precheck_stale; future as_of is additionally rejected at the commit layer as future_date before precheck.

HTTP is split into import-submit/ history_read (owner/finance/auditor, disabled-module history still readable) and import-submit-commit/ business_write (owner/finance), matching the plugin runtime GET/POST method semantics.
persist_preview performs no audit or canonical event write; only the append-only receipt and owner-service audits provide traceability after commit.
No canonical entity/topic/command is added and core/imports.py is unchanged; all row writes still go through apply_rows owner services.

Independent review blocker: rows were not bound to the submitted period, so a valid current-month precheck could admit a prior-month row; commit/dry_run now reject any row whose business date month differs from period (row_date_invalid), with regression tests.
dry_run validates preview/precheck/conflicts/row-period but not owner row rules; would_commit means those stages passed, owner rejection is returned on real commit.
resolve_conflict has no company lock/select_for_update; concurrent resolution is deferred to a follow-up slice.
Persistent preview HTTP upload is not exposed in this slice; persist_preview is a service API and the submit page is present.

Final verify-change uses the rebased BASE 8e3f877 and reports only high_risk_review_required; the original a70d3eb BASE would now flag PH-122-merged files as out of scope, which is why the rebase was required.
